profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Extensive software engineering experience in building high throughput data processing system, backend architecture, and web service. 

Language: Java, Python, SQL, NoSQL, JavaScript
Technical Skills: Kafka, RESTful, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, AWS Redshift, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Junit, Postman, Spark, Hadoop, MapReduce, Object-Oriented Design, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a high-capacity Kafka data processing system with 4 microservices  that manages and monitors over 50 data pipelines, Designed the system to handle high concurrency I/O. Used Spring Boot, Kafka, Avro, and AWS S3 to maintain data accuracy with no loss.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Kafka · Web Development · Dynamic System Configuration · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · System Design and Architecture · Concurrency and Thread Safety · Performance Optimization

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs and Microservices Pipeline to persist user data, and perform real-time data streaming of user behavior data using RabbitMQ & AWS
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · WebSocket · Java · Web Development · Mockito · Spring Security · Amazon Kinesis · RabbitMQ · Amazon Redshift · Junits · Amazon S3 · Test Automation
